name: Rebekah Mercer

summary.text: Rebekah Mercer is a daughter of hedge fund executive and Republican donor Robert Mercer. Companies House lists her as a director of Emerdata Limited, a London company formed in 2017 and associated with the Cambridge Analytica and SCL Group executives, appointed on 16 March 2018. Her father said in November 2017 that he was selling his stake in Breitbart News to his daughters, and in August 2016 The Hill reported on the Mercers' links to the Trump campaign's leadership changes.

sources.title: Robert Mercer Sells Stake in Breitbart Citing Disagreements with Bannon and Milo
Billionaire father and daughter linked to Trump shake-up

facts.claim: Companies House records list Rebekah Mercer as an active director of Emerdata Limited (company 10911848), appointed 16 March 2018; her sister Jennifer Mercer was appointed the same day. The register shows the company's status as 'In Administration'.

Emerdata Limited was incorporated in August 2017; corporate filings reported in 2018 listed Alexander Nix as a director until his resignation on 28 March 2018, and Johnson Chun Shun Ko among three directors appointed on 23 January 2018.

openQuestions: Reports that Rebekah Mercer sat on Cambridge Analytica's board were not confirmed from a source opened here; record only if the owner finds the underlying New York Times or Companies House record.
The size of the Mercer stake in Breitbart (reported as nearly 50% for $10 million in 2011) comes from New York Times reporting that was not reached directly.
Whether Rebekah Mercer took over day-to-day leadership of Make America Number 1 after David Bossie left in 2016 was stated only by tertiary sources.
